rows.ja: 真似しないで欲しいんですけど
rows.line: もう流れそう。じゃ、真似しないで欲しいんですけど。
rows.en1: Don't try this at home, though.
rows.en2: Please don't copy me on this one.

rows.ja: ちょっとこれググってほしい
rows.line: ごめん、曖昧なんで、ちょっとこれ皆さんググってほしい。
rows.en1: Don't quote me on that, look it up.
rows.en2: I'm fuzzy on this, so Google it.

rows.ja: 気づいたら〜してました
rows.line: 気づいたらここに踏み入れてました。
rows.en1: Next thing I knew, I was in there.
rows.en2: Before I knew it, I'd wandered in.

rows.line: 境界線を超えない限り、あんま不法侵入にならない。
rows.en1: as long as you don't cross the line
rows.en2: unless you actually go over the fence

rows.ja: 気にしなくていいんだな
rows.line: あんま気にしなくていいんだなって思えるようになった。
rows.en1: I realized I don't really need to sweat it.
rows.en2: Now I'm like, eh, it's no big deal.

rows.line: って言った後で、これなんか不法侵入を推奨するやつみたいになるな。
rows.en1: Wait, now that I've said it out loud...
rows.en2: Hold on, hearing myself say that...

rows.line: 僕もうてっきり、裏道があるんですとか言うと思ったら。
rows.en1: I totally thought you were going to say...
rows.en2: I was sure you were about to say...

rows.line: 皆さんに耳寄り情報いくつもあるはずなんですよ。
rows.en1: I've got some good tips for you guys.
rows.en2: I should have a few hot tips somewhere.

rows.line: Amazonギフト券を事実上の銀行として見立てると。
rows.en1: It's basically a bank.
rows.en2: For all intents and purposes, it's a bank.

rows.line: あ、ちょっと面白そう。どういうこと？
rows.en1: Ooh, that sounds interesting. What do you mean?
rows.en2: Okay, I'm listening. How so?

rows.line: これとかちょっと面白い見方だなって思いましたね。
rows.en1: That's an interesting way to look at it.
rows.en2: Never thought of it like that.

rows.line: でもAmazonギフト券使えなくて困りがちですけどね。
rows.en1: You always end up stuck with them, though.
rows.en2: Problem is, I can never use them up.

rows.line: ありがたいことに、誕生日イベントとかやるとさ。
rows.en1: Thankfully, whenever I do a birthday thing...
rows.en2: I'm lucky, people always...

rows.line: 残高が18万とかになってさ。そんなあるんだ、すごいな。
rows.en1: Wait, that much? Damn.
rows.en2: Seriously? That's a lot.

rows.line: どうせ私じゃなくて全自動卓目当てなんでしょ。
rows.en1: You're only here for the table, aren't you?
rows.en2: It's not me you want, it's the table.

rows.line: 全自動卓目当てでちやほやされて。
rows.en1: everyone's all over me
rows.en2: people are sucking up to me

rows.ja: 自己肯定感めっちゃ低いやつみたい
rows.line: 悲しい、自己肯定感めっちゃ低いやつみたいなこと言うじゃん。
rows.en1: That's such a sad, low self-esteem thing to say.
rows.en2: Man, you sound so insecure.

rows.line: 単体ではさ、僕の家に行ってもしょうがないけどさ。
rows.en1: There's no point coming over just for me.
rows.en2: Nobody's coming over just to see me.

rows.line: そりゃそうでしょ、もちろん。
rows.en1: Well, obviously.
rows.en2: Duh, of course.

rows.line: ピースをある程度まで指定できるとか。ああ、聞いたことある。
rows.en1: Oh, I've heard of that.
rows.en2: Yeah, that rings a bell.

rows.line: 何回も聞くと頭に入ってくるじゃん、響きで。
rows.en1: It just sticks in your head.
rows.en2: It sinks in after a while.

rows.ja: どっかで話したかもしんないけど
rows.line: なんかどっかで話したかもしんないけど。
rows.en1: I might've told this one before, but...
rows.en2: Stop me if you've heard this...

rows.line: 読んでないだろお前、多分だけど。
rows.en1: You didn't actually read it, did you?
rows.en2: Be honest, you never read it.

rows.line: えっと、だから……全部忘れましたね。
rows.en1: Yeah, I forgot all of it.
rows.en2: Nope, it's all gone.

rows.line: 全部忘れましたね。ふざけんなよマジで。
rows.en1: Are you kidding me?
rows.en2: Come on, seriously?

rows.line: 面白かったなってなるんだけどさ、驚くほど何も覚えてない。
rows.en1: I remember literally nothing.
rows.en2: It's amazing how little sticks.

rows.line: 読み飛ばしていく箇所が30ページあるのってさ、一周回って得してる。
rows.en1: It's actually a win, if you think about it.
rows.en2: Weirdly, that works in your favor.

rows.line: 読む分減ってるんだから損してると思いがちなんだけど。
rows.en1: You'd think you're getting ripped off, but...
rows.en2: Most people would call that a rip-off, but...

rows.line: そこで読み終わったことにすると1番コスパですよ。
rows.en1: That's the best bang for your buck.
rows.en2: Best value, hands down.

rows.line: 尻上がりに面白くなるケースもあるから。ああ、それが怖いんだよね。
rows.en1: Yeah, that's what scares me.
rows.en2: That's the part I'm worried about.

rows.line: 読書に真面目すぎる人いっぱいいるからね。
rows.en1: A lot of people take reading way too seriously.
rows.en2: People are way too uptight about reading.

rows.ja: 聞いていいならですけど
rows.line: あとさ、あの、聞いていいならですけど。
rows.en1: If you don't mind me asking...
rows.en2: If it's okay to ask...

rows.line: 新婚生活どうだろ。でもあんま変わんないんだよな。
rows.en1: Honestly, not much has changed.
rows.en2: It's pretty much the same.

rows.ja: 〜のめんどくさいなみたいな
rows.line: なんか引っ越すのめんどくさいなみたいな。
rows.en1: Moving just feels like such a hassle.
rows.en2: We can't really be bothered to move.
